summary: Two people say they met in school.
realLife: An elderly couple, both born in the same Iowa town, said they met in school and had been married seventy-seven years.
sources: University of Minnesota Morris, Roy and Frieda Simpson interview, about 1977: https://digitalcommons.morris.umn.edu/kmrs/88/
inGame: `household:partners-met` with `other` and `place`. `needs:` a record that the place was a school.
